scope: Manual source-file comparison; not full repository superiority or live hardware certification.

remaining: This native overlay mapping is not shared Web/TUI message-delivery parity.

preserved: Byte-identical actual Phosphor rasterizer, centered glyph coverage, all seven ICO resolutions, bottom-up BGRA, DWORD-aligned AND masks and explicit directory offsets. Pakar build.rs uses it for PE, tray and action assets.
remaining: User-configurable icon packs and runtime state-icon transitions are a separate unresolved integration; retaining the generator does not implement that editor.

preserved: Actual typed action/resource catalog, equality traits, explicit negative resource-index selection, Preferences, Exit and generic Toggle fullscreen. Controller actions share the launch/IPC dispatcher and resource compiler.

omissions.code: Play / Pause, Previous chapter, Next chapter, Mute / Unmute media quick actions
omissions.reason: Pakar intentionally has no mpv playback, chapters or media volume. These would call removed media business methods. Connect, device settings, refresh, workspaces and About are real controller navigation actions instead; generic fullscreen is retained, not misclassified as media-only.

remaining: Visible Windows Jump List clicks remain a manual acceptance gate; typed launch forwarding and resource uniqueness are tested.

preserved: Default Preferences Ctrl+, and device configuration Ctrl+Shift+, navigation exist; F11 fullscreen is restored with the shared typed dispatcher. These are not equivalent to the donor persisted rebinding model.

omissions.code: ApplicationShortcuts persisted fields, parse_shortcut, entries, validate, action_for_event and their non-media tests
omissions.reason: The foundation hardcoded its accelerators and omitted the reusable binding model. No accepted reason justifies leaving rebinding out. The actual donor depends on KeyChord and hardware_shortcuts match/key-code helpers, which must be ported and tested with controller-specific typed actions rather than guessed labels.

omissions.code: take_frame_step_shortcut and frame-step tests
omissions.reason: These consume Ctrl+Left/Right for media frame stepping and timeline transport. Those business domains were explicitly removed; Pakar must not hijack ordinary text word navigation for nonexistent video frames.

omissions.code: containing_media_folder and local-media path tests
omissions.reason: This resolves media files/streams, not board identities or firmware files. Firmware selection already uses explicit native file dialogs; introducing a nonexistent media folder action would be misleading.

omissions.code: media_information and media_folder accelerators
omissions.reason: The media operations cannot be retained as-is, but their reusable information/folder-navigation affordances need explicit hardware-monitor and application-folder action decisions. They are not silently treated as completed controller mappings.

remaining: Restore validated persistent rebinding, exact-modifier matching, repeat/release rejection and text-edit protection; separately reconcile global/hardware shortcut ownership.

preserved: Actual Preferences action/resource catalog is validated; invalid HWND registration rejects rather than claiming success; owner exclusion is tested. Live notification acceptance and shown-callback evidence are recorded independently.

omissions.code: Playback-duration error/paused percentages and Play/Pause thumbnail/tray labels
omissions.reason: The tests model removed video playback, not device transfer progress. Pakar uses indeterminate taskbar activity only for a real pending settings/maintenance request; inventing a media percentage would publish false progress.

omissions.code: PealayerApp::default and media playback_time/duration/is_paused assignments
omissions.reason: Pakar is an executable-only mpv-free controller; creating the donor media engine is inappropriate. Actual controller IPC/live smoke and direct invalid-HWND tests exercise its own lifetime instead.

omissions.code: ensure_shell_initialized retry and repeated shell-lifecycle acceptance
omissions.reason: Tray creation failures are visible and close-to-tray cannot hide an app without a tray, but complete root-taskbar initialization/retry and Explorer restart acceptance are not covered by the current tests.

remaining: Add root-taskbar lifecycle/reinitialization and hidden-window/tray/notification-click acceptance without fabricating successful HWND installation.

preserved: Timer1 OC1A PB1/D9 hardware output without audio ISR; ten-step nonblocking ring queue; silent pauses; begin/stop/mute and active telemetry.
PCController already uses Timer1 hardware toggling; that is reuse, not a Pakar invention.

omissions.code: now + step.durationMs; nondelegating default constructor; stale idle active-frequency metadata
omissions.reason: Pakar delegates construction, anchors the next step to the previous deadline, skips fully expired steps, and zeros idle metadata. Register-double tests exercise late calls, wraparound and idle state.

omissions.code: Permissive enqueue of unsupported frequency/zero-duration requests
omissions.reason: Rejecting zero durations and nonzero frequencies outside 20..20000 Hz matches the bounded wire contract and avoids silently scheduling an unplayable request.

remaining: Physical timing, mute/unmute acoustics and supply/clock validity remain issue #2 gates.
files.improvement: Tested late-loop and wraparound timing without cumulative melody-length drift; initialized default construction; validation at enqueue; unmute restarts the active tone.

preserved: Ten queued tones/pauses and PB1/D9 buzzer ownership; note constants retained in pitches.h.

omissions.code: waitForTonesEnd blocking loop
omissions.reason: Nonblocking update() plus isBusy() preserves completion observation while allowing UART, input and front-panel services to run; a busy wait would starve those required services.

omissions.code: Global addTone/resetTone/playToneSequence state/functions and millis()+duration deadline
omissions.reason: Object-owned enqueue/stop/update retains queue lifecycle and avoids namespace/global ownership collisions; deadline anchoring and signed rollover comparisons replace accumulating loop delay.

omissions.code: Unbounded frequency and zero-duration acceptance
